fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects dropping of dll files in system32 that may be used to retrieve user credentials from LSASS
fields.name: Dropping Of Password Filter DLL
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "scecli\\0" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "reg add"))
